text:
In retrospect, our April 2013 record centers on airports. Eleven of us said "air traffic control"; seven said "air traffic control towers." Eight of us reached "flight delays act" and seven "the reducing flight delays act," both surfacing on 2013-04-26. Ten of us said "the president's budget," peaking 2013-04-10. Seven of us said "look forward to working." And seven of us said "thoughts and prayers," six of us "thoughts and prayers are with," on 2013-04-15.

We note that several of these phrases we did not originate: "the president's budget" first appears from Tim Walberg, "flight delays act" and "the reducing flight delays act" from Lisa Murkowski, "thoughts and prayers are with" from Chuck Grassley. We converged on language first said across the aisle.

That is the shape of the month as we recorded it: control towers, a budget, a delays act, and, on the fifteenth, prayers.
